# GlobalSync AI

> A free premium toolkit and resource center helping remote teams, digital nomads, and freelancers coordinate seamlessly across time zones, currencies, and global payroll equivalents.

## Tools
- [Time Zone Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/time-zone-converter) - Live world clocks and timezone offset comparisons for over 25 major hubs.
- [Meeting Planner](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/meeting-planner) - Visual business hour overlap mapping for distributed team coordination.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/currency-converter) - Real mid-market foreign exchange calculator covering 160+ world currencies.
- [Freelancer Rate Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/freelancer-rate-converter) - Standard hourly rate to W-2 corporate annual salary equivalence formulas.

## Guides
- [Best Time to Call India from US for Business](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/blog/best-time-to-call-india-from-us-for-business) - Practical coordination tables for engineering teams in the US and India.
- [How to Schedule Meetings Across Multiple Time Zones Fairly](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/blog/how-to-schedule-meetings-across-multiple-time-zones-fairly) - Smart team rotation frameworks to reduce remote work fatigue.
- [Freelancer Rate Calculator: Hourly to Annual](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/blog/freelancer-rate-calculator-hourly-to-annual) - W-2 salary comparisons including self-employment overhead buffers.
- [USD to PKR Freelancers Guide](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/blog/usd-to-pkr-freelancers-how-to-price) - Pricing leverage strategies for South Asian remote agencies.
- [Daylight Saving Time Changes 2026 for Remote Teams](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/blog/daylight-saving-time-changes-2026-remote-teams) - Critical DST transitions and calendars for distributed workforce coordination.
